title: The Picture That Left Someone Out
youtube_title: The Picture That Left Someone Out | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Brigid is just outside the fun, close to a group picture posed before everyone was in it. Nim changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Brigid has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
